description: This file defines the PayGradeCurrency entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_pay_grade_currency' database table. It includes properties for pay grade, currency type, salary ranges, and corresponding getter/setter methods, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrency
classes.description: Entity class representing pay grade currency details, including associated pay grade, currency type, and salary bounds.

methods.name: getCurrencyId
methods.description: Returns the currency ID associated with this PayGradeCurrency.

methods.name: setCurrencyId
methods.description: Sets the currency ID for this PayGradeCurrency.

methods.name: getPayGradeId
methods.description: Returns the pay grade ID associated with this record.
